Ft.bar_b_note: A flat grey plaza with no visible sky, flat white shaft planes (A) or a dim torch-lit grade (B), floor-disc telegraphs and HUD panels walling both sides sink it well below Palworld's boss-fight read and nothing says sky realm.

Pb.bar_b_note: B's mottled scaled serpent with open fanged mouth gets close to the owner's naturalistic bar, but A's glossy plastic banding and levitating S-curve faint poses keep the set short of shipping finish.

Vy.bar_b_note: A clean, appealing stylised elder with readable eyes, soft hair and beard, and a warm earth-and-moss costume that fits the key art's village carries it to a shipping-character finish.

Jg.bar_b_note: A near-black forest with no purple storm sky or lightning, a barely visible player creature, magenta floor shapes and (A) the camera buried in trunks and canopy leave it nowhere near Palworld's forest boss fight.

Gt.bar_b_note: The meadow grass, sky and mountains are close, but a lone thin wall panel beside a washed-out low-poly rock does not read like Palworld's lived-in base building.

top_changes.change: Replace the flat magenta/white floor rings, slabs and rectangles in Ft and Jg with object-based telegraphs and impacts (stone, lightning, wind) that have a real hit moment, and add distinct hurt and moving poses

Relight and restage the combat arenas: Cloudreach gets a visible bright sky, pale stratified stone and no flat white shaft planes; Stormwood gets a lifted value range, the purple storm sky, rim light on both fighters and a camera that fades or avoids trunks and canopy; the combat camera keeps the ally small enough that the opponent and player stay in view
Slim the combat HUD: collapse the full-height left and right panels into compact corner widgets so the centre and lower third show the fight at a glance on a 7-inch screen
